body:
Shouldn't this have used a 1.5x factor instead of 2x?

#100944 made this a `reserve()` call which would effectively behave like 1.5x. Why did it get reverted?

Asking because no one questioned.

Ohh, good catch! I must have missed the change on a rebase.

I think it's too late to re-introduce 1.5x growth factor now for 4.5, but I'll make a PR for early 4.6.
Edit: Oh right, this only affects `resize`. Then it's probably OK to do it for 4.5 still.
Shouldn't it say only new values get set to 0 / false / nullptr? Otherwise this description implies that it deletes all existing data in the vector.
Right, it only applies to new values.
